To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a constrained discriminative training approach which can keep some of the constraints in the score function of the trained model, and this approach can improve the performance of speaker verification.

we propose a new algorithm for discriminative training of PLDA for speaker verification, which is constrained by two important constraints, and our method obtains significant improvements in the male trials in telephone speaker verification tasks.

we have proposed a new constrained discriminatived training algorithm, which keeps the constraints that the log likelihood ratio score of the PLDA should follow, and we have shown the improvement of our algorithm in the male trials in the telephone speaker verification task of NIST S RE08 and SRE 10.

the following two issues.
the constrained discriminative PLDA model training.

the following two questions: (i) what are the constraints that the log likelihood ratio function of the PLSA model should satisfy; (ii) how to keep these constraints in the discriminative training process.
